about: Coaldale is a town in southern Alberta immediately east of Lethbridge on Highway 3, in irrigated prairie—not Lethbridge itself. A residential and agricultural service community, it is home to the Alberta Birds of Prey Centre. About 9,000 people live in Coaldale.
seoSummary: Town immediately east of Lethbridge on Highway 3—irrigated prairie and the Alberta Birds of Prey Centre, not Lethbridge.
knownFor: Town east of Lethbridge, not the City of Lethbridge
